sql:
WITH state_orders AS (
  SELECT
    u.state,
    u.id AS user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    oi.status,
    oi.sale_price,
    p.cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id
  WHERE u.state IN ('Texas', 'California')
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2024
)
SELECT
  state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), sale_price, 0)),
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), order_id, NULL))
  ), 2) AS aov,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), sale_price - cost, 0)),
    SUM(IF(status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'), sale_price, 0))
  ) * 100, 1) AS margin_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(status = 'Returned'), COUNTIF(status != 'Cancelled')) * 100, 1) AS return_rate_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)), 2) AS orders_per_customer
FROM state_orders
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT
  state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS registered_customers
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`
WHERE state IN ('Texas', 'California')
GROUP BY state

SELECT
  IF(DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE '2025-01-01', 'Q1 2025', 'Q4 2024') AS quarter,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost), 2) AS margin,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost), SUM(oi.sale_price)) * 100, 1) AS margin_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) AS customers,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price), COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id)), 2) AS aov,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(oi.status = 'Returned') * 100.0, COUNTIF(oi.status != 'Cancelled')), 1) AS return_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') OR oi.status = 'Returned'
  AND DATE(oi.created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter DESC

SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE '2025-01-01', oi.sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue_q1_2025,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(DATE(oi.created_at) < DATE '2025-01-01', oi.sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue_q4_2024,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE '2025-01-01', oi.sale_price, 0)), SUM(IF(DATE(oi.created_at) < DATE '2025-01-01', oi.sale_price, 0))) - 1, 4) * 100 AS growth_qoq_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND DATE(oi.created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue_q1_2025 DESC
